ice_df_table <- ice_df

# Change n/a values to "-"
ice_df_table$Age[is.na(ice_df_table$Age)] <- "-"
ice_df_table$State[is.na(ice_df_table$State)] <- "-"
ice_df_table$City[is.na(ice_df_table$City)] <- "-"
ice_df_table$County[is.na(ice_df_table$County)] <- "-"
ice_df_table$`Cause of Death (Official)`[is.na(ice_df_table$`Cause of Death (Official)`)] <- "-"
ice_df_table$`Cause of Death (Unofficial)`[is.na(ice_df_table$`Cause of Death (Unofficial)`)] <- "-"
ice_df_table$`Facilities & Transfers`[is.na(ice_df_table$`Facilities & Transfers`)] <- "-"
ice_df_table$`Other Notes`[is.na(ice_df_table$`Other Notes`)] <- "-"

# Drop Drive Link to Sources Column
ice_df_table <- ice_df_table %>% select(-`Drive Link to Sources`)

```{r}
#| echo: false

library(reactable)
library(htmltools)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper function for long-text cells
# ------------------------------------------------------------

long_text <- function(value, preview_length = 60) {

  # Handle missing values
  if (is.null(value) || is.na(value) || value == "") {
    return("")
  }

  value <- as.character(value)

  # Create shortened preview
  preview <- if (nchar(value) > preview_length) {
    paste0(
      substr(value, 1, preview_length),
      "..."
    )
  } else {
    value
  }

  # Create tooltip
  div(
    class = "tooltip-cell",

    span(
      class = "tooltip-preview",
      preview
    ),

    span(
      class = "custom-tooltip",
      value
    )
  )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Reactable
# ------------------------------------------------------------

reactable(
  ice_df_table,

  class = "my-table",

  fullWidth = TRUE,

  bordered = FALSE,

  striped = TRUE,

  highlight = TRUE,

  compact = FALSE,

  resizable = TRUE,

  defaultPageSize = 15,

  paginationType = "jump",


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Default columns
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  defaultColDef = colDef(
    align = "left",

    headerStyle = list(
      fontWeight = "700"
    )
  ),


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Column-specific settings
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  columns = list(

    `Name` = colDef(
      minWidth = 200,
      width = 240
    ),

    `Date` = colDef(
      minWidth = 110,
      width = 120
    ),

    `Age` = colDef(
      minWidth = 70,
      width = 80,
      align = "center"
    ),

    `Gender` = colDef(
      minWidth = 100,
      width = 110
    ),

    `Location` = colDef(
      minWidth = 180,
      width = 220
    ),

    `Country` = colDef(
      minWidth = 120,
      width = 140
    ),

    `State` = colDef(
      minWidth = 100,
      width = 120
    ),

    `City` = colDef(
      minWidth = 140,
      width = 160
    ),

    `County` = colDef(
      minWidth = 140,
      width = 170
    ),

    `Latitude` = colDef(
      minWidth = 110,
      width = 120
    ),

    `Longitude` = colDef(
      minWidth = 110,
      width = 120
    ),

    `Custody` = colDef(
      minWidth = 130,
      width = 150
    ),


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Long text columns
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    `Cause of Death (Official)` = colDef(

      minWidth = 250,
      width = 300,

      cell = function(value) {
        long_text(
          value,
          preview_length = 70
        )
      }
    ),


    `Cause of Death (Unofficial)` = colDef(

      minWidth = 250,
      width = 300,

      cell = function(value) {
        long_text(
          value,
          preview_length = 70
        )
      }
    ),


    `Facilities & Transfers` = colDef(

      minWidth = 280,
      width = 350,

      cell = function(value) {
        long_text(
          value,
          preview_length = 70
        )
      }
    ),


    `Other Notes` = colDef(

      minWidth = 280,
      width = 350,

      cell = function(value) {
        long_text(
          value,
          preview_length = 70
        )
      }
    )
  )
)
```
